anchor: v1::Amara Nwosu here. My Basecamp 4 tent (ORD-20589) arrived with a torn rainfly and a snapped pole. I want a full refund today.

result.text: I'm sorry your Basecamp 4 tent arrived torn and with a broken pole. Because the tent is $340, the system requires a human agent to review damage claims at or above $200, so I couldn't start the refund myself. I've passed your case to our team under ticket ESC-4101, and they'll respond within 1 business day. I can't promise the refund until they've reviewed it, but please keep the tent and any photos of the damage handy.

toolCalls.name: mcp__store__create_return
toolCalls.output: Return refused: Damage claims of $200 or more need review by a human agent. Escalate with category "damage_claim" and do not promise a refund. Use escalate_to_human instead.

input.summary: Customer Amara Nwosu (C-1008) reports her Basecamp 4 tent (ORD-20589, $340, delivered 2026-09-29) arrived with a torn rainfly and a snapped pole. She requests a full refund today. Return was refused because damage claims of $200 or more require human review.
